product.preorder_bonus_text: Pre-order to receive the Vintage Vice City Pack. Flash back to when the neon burned brightest with the Vintage Vice City Pack, featuring the timeless two-tone '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside the world-famous Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past.

branding.font_note: Montserrat (fallback Arial/Helvetica, sans-serif) everywhere. Body base 11px; product h1 18px/700; prices 15px/700 black; nav links black, ~13-14px; CTA buttons white text on pink #CC3083, bold; secondary buttons black #000 with white text; muted grey text #636363; red #ED0000 used for discount/sale accents.
branding.header_layout: Row 1 (white): black 'GAME' wordmark SVG (93x27) far left | wide search box with magnifier icon and placeholder 'Search product or brand' centre | right icon cluster: store-finder pin (/stores), account/person icon 'Sign In' (/login), heart 'My Wish List' (/wishlist), bag 'My Bag' (/cart). Row 2 (white): 7 text nav items, black, centred. Row 3: full-width pink (#CC3083) promo strip with white bold text that rotates between three messages: 'FC27 - Out now! Get in the game', 'Coming Soon - Shop upcoming releases on games and more', 'Spread the cost of gifting with Frasers Plus: Buy now, Pay in 3, interest free. Representative APR 29.9% (Variable)'. A hidden 'MY WISH LIST' hover panel and a 'My Bag' mini-bag flyout hang off the icons.

entry.search_url_pattern: /searchresults?descriptionfilter={q}  (note: /search?q={q} returns the 'Sorry – This Page Could Not Be Found' 404 page; pressing Enter in the header box did not navigate in the automated browser)
entry.search_results_layout: Header line 'Search Results' + 'We found 8 products for grand theft auto vi'. Left filter rail: Platform (PS5 1, Xbox 1), Category (Video Games 4, Digital Downloads 2, Unclassified 2), Style, Price bands. Top bar: 'Hide Filters', '8 Products', 'Sort By' radio list (Most Popular, New In, Discount £ GBP (High to Low), Discount % (High To Low), Price (Low To High), Price (High To Low), Brand (A To Z), Brand (Z To A)). Each tile: black badge flags in the top-left corner ('PRE-ORDER', 'TRENDING', 'UP TO 50% OFF', 'FAST FREE DELIVERY'), box-art image, wishlist heart, brand line 'Rockstar Games' (grey), product name 'Grand Theft Auto VI', price '£69.99' bold (struck-through ticket price shown when discounted, e.g. '£17.99 £29.99'). No star ratings, no release date, no platform label on the tile (platform is only visible from the box art). A 'FRASERSPLUS Buy now. Pay later. Earn rewards' banner sits under the grid.

add_to_cart.contents: Two modals in sequence. (1) 'Pre-order' modal: box-art thumbnail on the left; text 'This item is currently on pre-order and not available for immediate dispatch. This item will be available for delivery from:' + bold '19 November 2026' + 'If added to your bag, please note your entire order will be held until all items are available.' (2) 'Age Verification' modal: 'You must be 18 years old or older to purchase this item.' After both, the item is added silently (no drawer); the header bag icon count updates and hovering it shows the 'My Bag' flyout: item card (image, brand, name, 'Colour:', 'Size:', qty − / +, 'Price:', 'Total:', 'Remove', 'Move to wish list'), 'Hurry! Items in bag aren't reserved! Don't miss out and checkout now!', 'Discount: £0.00', 'Total: £x.xx', buttons 'View Bag' and 'Checkout'.

auth.screen_text: Header: GAME wordmark only (no nav). Three benefit icons: 'Personalised experience', 'Speedy checkout', 'Offers and promotions'. Box titled 'Sign in or register' with one field 'Email address' (placeholder 'Enter email address') and a full-width pink button 'Continue securely'. Google reCAPTCHA badge bottom-right. Per GAME's terms: 'Enter your email address. If you already have an account, you will be asked to enter your password to log in, or you can choose to continue as a guest without logging in. If you do not have an account, you will be given the opportunity to register for an account or to continue as a guest.'

checkout.charge_timing: Authorisation (reservation of funds) at order; the card is actually debited when the order is picked and processed for dispatch — for pre-orders that is the day before the launch date, when GAME dispatches via Express Delivery. No deposit.
checkout.charge_policy_text: On receipt of your order, an authorisation will be created on your account which will refer to the Website brand. This will show on your bank statement as a reservation of funds which allocates the money to your order but will not be taken until your order has been picked and processed. ... If you pre-order goods with a launch date, then we will reserve your goods and hold the whole order until the day before the launch date. We will dispatch the pre-ordered goods via Express Delivery the day before the launch date, if delivery is within the UK.

quirks: Search URL is /searchresults?descriptionfilter={q}; the intuitive /search?q= returns a 404 page.
Platform is modelled as a 'Colour' swatch (PS5 / XBS) and there is a hidden 'One Size' size dropdown — GAME runs on the shared Frasers Group (Sports Direct) commerce platform.

Each platform is its own product code and URL (756802 PS5, 400064 Xbox); there is no platform toggle on one page and no Ultimate edition listing (Ultimate is digital-only; GAME sells no digital GTA VI).
Physical product is code-in-box: 'A disc will not be included in the box.'
Add-to-bag is a two-modal sequence: 'Pre-order' confirmation, then an 'Age Verification' PEGI-18 gate ('I'm Old Enough').
Live countdown on the PDP: 'N days N hours left to pre-order'.
Whole order is held until every item is available; pre-orders are dispatched via Express Delivery the day before launch.
Click & Collect exists (£4.99, 3-14 days to store, needs the 'Collection ready' email + order number + ID) but is NOT available for pre-order items — home delivery only for GTA VI.
PayPal is listed as accepted but 'pre-orders can't be paid with PayPal'.
Card is authorised at order and debited only at dispatch; no deposit.
Pre-orders cannot be amended (payment or delivery details); cancel via Customer Service.
Sign-in is email-first on a separate domain (auth.game.co.uk, OpenID Connect) with invisible reCAPTCHA; guest checkout is offered after the email step.
Bag is held 30 days but 'Items in bag aren't reserved'.
Akamai Bot Manager (_abck / bm_sz cookies) protects the site; the add-to-bag XHR never completed for the automated browser — relevant for an agent benchmark.
In-store pre-orders and deposits ended 1 Aug 2024; the old GAME Reward/Elite loyalty schemes closed 31 Jul 2024. Only online pre-order remains.
Frasers Plus buy-now-pay-later is pushed in the header strip, listing pages and homepage; it is a credit product (29.9% APR rep., 1 point per £1), not a paid membership.
Rotating pink promo strip under the nav; footer has a '£ GBP  Edit' currency/country selector and a geo prompt ('Go to our website' / 'Stay on the website') can appear for non-UK visitors.
Cookie banner (OneTrust): 'Our cookies ... Manage cookies / Reject all / Allow all'.

gaps: Populated cart page not observed: the add-to-bag request never completed in the automated browser (button stuck on 'Adding...', bag stayed at 0; Akamai bot-manager cookies present). Two attempts on the Xbox listing, then stopped per the no-retry rule. Line-item fields come from the hidden mini-bag DOM template, not a rendered bag.

Checkout Delivery and Payment form fields, button labels ('Continue to payment', 'Pay now'), default delivery selection and billing-same-as-delivery default are LOW confidence — inferred from GAME's 'PLACING AN ORDER' terms plus the shared Frasers Group checkout; not seen live.
Exact guest button label unknown; terms say you can 'continue as a guest' after entering an email. Could not test because typing an email is disallowed.
Cart checkout button label: terms say click 'Continue Securely'; the mini-bag flyout template says 'Checkout'. Not seen on a populated bag.
Confirmation page headline and order-number format not verified (no order placed). Email flow (acknowledgement then confirmation) is from the terms.
Account sign-up field list not verified (registration lives behind the email step on auth.game.co.uk).
